record.body:
## Description

Prove exit criteria: phase screen through the real dashboard entry, model and pilot suites, then full suite.

## Approach

1. Run dashboard/bin/dashboard --once or integration pilots that open the phase screen at Spec.
2. Run model -k phase_screen and tests/test_dashboard_phase_screen.py.
3. Run the full non-tmux then tmux suites.
record.subject: verify-spec-view
